_om: Lurendreieren in English (Chancer, rusj.no/en/chancer/) – liar's dice with bids: five hidden dice each, bid higher or call ‘Liar!’. Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Ny runde – {navn} begynner og kan si hva: New round – {navn} starts and can bid anything.
{n} terninger på bordet. Enere er jokere: {n} dice on the table. Ones are wild and count as anything.
{navn} is the last one with dice.
There were none on the table.
{navn} har forlatt kampen – ingen mister: {navn} has left the match – nobody loses anything.
{navn} mister den siste terningen og er: {navn} loses their last die and is out!
Alle har skjulte terninger. By på hvor m: Everyone has hidden dice. Bid on how many of a number there are in all – true or a bluff. If you don't believe the bid, call ‘Liar!’.
Alle kaster terningene sine – fem hver,: Everyone rolls their dice – five each, or three in a quick game. Only you see your own.
Et bud er for eksempel «minst fire femme: A bid is, say, ‘at least four fives’ – among all the dice on the table. The next bid has to be higher: more dice, or as many of a higher number.
Da vises alle terningene. Stemte budet,: Then all the dice are shown. If the bid was true, the caller loses a die. If it was a bluff, the bidder does. The last one with dice left wins.
Enere er jokere og teller som alt, så in: Ones are wild and count as anything, so nobody can bid on ones. You can switch wild ones off in the settings.
Den som mistet en terning, begynner nest: Whoever lost a die starts the next round.
Regn litt: med jokere viser omtrent hver: Do the maths: with wild ones, about one die in three shows what you're bidding on.
På nett viser hver mobil bare sine egne: Online, each phone shows only its own dice. On one phone, the phone goes round the table and you hold your finger on the card to see yours.
Mobilen går rundt bordet i denne rekkefø: The phone goes round the table in this order.
Hvor mange terninger hver spiller har: How many dice each player has
En ener teller som hvilket som helst tal: A one counts as any number.
De andre ser bort mens {navn} kikker på: Everyone else looks away while {navn} peeks at their dice.
Hold fingeren på kortet for å se: Hold your finger on the card to see
Dine terninger. Hold fingeren på kortet: Your dice. Hold your finger on the card to see them
Ingen kan by høyere enn dette. Rop «Løgn: Nobody can bid higher than this. Call ‘Liar!’.
Spillet ble avsluttet før det var ferdig: The game was stopped before it finished.
Kveldens lurendreier: {navn} – {antall}: Chancer of the night: {navn} – {antall} got through.
Ingen har mistet en terning ennå. Dere k: Nobody has lost a die yet. You can always start a new game.
Dere går rett til kåringen. Flest ternin: You'll go straight to the results. Most dice left leads.
